[2-Hour All You Can Drink] Private rooms Monja Koboreya

Experience the original Monja and Okonomiyaki course at "Private rooms Monja Koboreya" to your heart's content. Enjoy our signature dishes, such as "Koboreya" and "Blissful Margherita," which uniquely blend Japanese and Western flavors, and cannot be found anywhere else.

This course is a must-try for first-time visitors to Tsukishima Monja. Enjoy the beloved local flavors of pork and Baby Star sauce, the classic Tsukishima-style Mentai Monja made with the highest quality mentaiko, special soy sauce yakisoba with chewy noodles, and fluffy okonomiyaki crafted with care. *This menu is offered at our sister restaurant, Private Rooms Monja Koboreya.
